How many sessions are INCLUDED with the iPOWER Moves PRIVATE Pre-Licensing Classes?
?✓
✱

Which license should I start with?
?✓
✱

The 2-15 bundles Health, Life & Annuities in ONLY 60 hours — saving you 10 hours.

Why do our instructors recommend Florida’s Health & Life Insurance License, which INCLUDES Annuities and Variable Contracts?
?✓
✱

MOST career options. We also feel the exam is slightly easier – we elaborate in detail during Orientation.

How do I apply for a license?
?✓
✱

Your State Application is $55 — $50 plus $5 for your Florida license ID card — paid directly to the Florida Department of Financial Services.

Where do I go for fingerprints?
?✓
✱

Fingerprinting is a required background check. It typically runs $62–$75 depending on provider, paid at your fingerprint appointment.

How do I schedule my state exam?
?✓
✱

Through Pearson VUE. The State Exam Fee is $44 per attempt, paid when you schedule.

Is any of the $174 paid to The Insurance School?
?✓
✱

No. Every state licensing fee is paid to the state or its vendors — never to us.

How long does it usually take to be able to sell your first policy?
?✓
✱

If you’re ambitious… maybe 30 days. On average, 45 days with insurer appointments and training.
